visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a multi-colored pastel (blue, pink, yellow, green) jacket over a striped shirt, pops her head out from behind a large yellow cardboard box. The setting is a narrow outdoor alleyway with beige brick walls. White variety text overlays appear on screen. (2) The scene shifts to a POV shot from inside a moving vehicle. Outside the window, the Taipei Dome is visible under a clear, bright blue sky with scattered white clouds. Green palm trees line the foreground. (3) The woman is now indoors in a grey, utilitarian storage room. She points at a large, upright white commercial refrigerator that is still wrapped in clear protective plastic. (4) The woman walks through a brightly lit indoor corridor with grey concrete floors. She gestures towards a closed metal rolling shutter door on her right. (5) A close-up shot shows the metal rolling shutter door being lowered or raised. (6) The woman stands in an indoor space with a wooden wall partition. She gestures with both hands, explaining the layout. She carries a small red and black Mickey Mouse bag. (7) A wide shot from the spectator stands looks out over the baseball field of the Taipei Dome. The field is green, and rows of empty blue and grey seats are visible. (8) The woman is kneeling on a grey concrete floor, assembling a white retractable roll-up banner. She is focused on the task, looking down at the base of the banner. (9) The banner is partially revealed, showing images of tea drinks and the brand name 'NAP TEA' with a sloth logo. The woman looks up at the camera and laughs. (10) The woman pushes a white three-tiered rolling utility cart through a wide, empty indoor hallway. The lighting is bright and industrial. (11) She points toward a far corner of the hallway, indicating a location. There are various black cables and equipment on the floor. (12) The shot captures a panoramic view of the baseball field from a different angle in the stands. Blue seats fill the foreground. (13) The woman is shown unfolding a grey plastic folding crate that doubles as a table on top of a flatbed cart. She works with her hands, fitting the parts together. (14) She places a white plastic menu board on top of the crates. The menu features images of different tea beverages. (15) She applies a white adhesive label to the wooden wall. Her hands are visible as she carefully aligns the sticker. (16) A close-up shot shows the interior of the white commercial refrigerator. The woman is placing small white labels with the names of drinks on the front edges of the wire shelves. (17) The woman stands in front of her newly set up booth. Behind her, banners for 'NAP TEA' and 'Blackball' are visible. She talks directly to the camera with animated hand gestures. (18) A close-up shot of a white plastic storage bin. A hand (male) applies a sticker with a sloth drinking tea onto the front of the bin. (19) The woman stands in the middle of the hallway, smiling and waving both arms toward the camera in an inviting manner. The stall is visible in the background. (20) A close-up shot shows a large menu board for 'Blackball' sweet potato balls, featuring cartoon characters and prices. (21) The woman is seen in a profile view, laughing heartily. The background is a blurred view of the stadium corridor.

The female voice reacts with a short, surprised giggle. (4) A transient sound of plastic rustling and a dull thud (placing an object) occurs. The BGM remains steady. (5) The female voice laughs loudly, reaching a higher pitch. A 'pop' sound effect highlights a text overlay. (6) A metallic click and scraping sound of folding furniture is audible. The female voice narrates her actions in a rapid, energetic pace. (7) A soft 'ding' sound effect marks the appearance of a brand logo. The voices overlap as the man and woman exchange casual remarks about the beverage labels. (8) The female speaker's voice becomes more projected as she calls out to potential customers at the end of the recording. The BGM fades out slightly as the laughter concludes.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Prep stage -> Location reveals -> Setup details -> Final booth showcase.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video document's a behind-the-scenes look at the creator setting up a food and beverage booth (NAP TEA and Blackball) at the Taipei Dome. It aims to build excitement for an upcoming event and promote the featured brands through an engaging, personal vlog style.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Frequent display of brand logos (NAP TEA, Blackball), menu showcases, and the creator actively preparing the stall for sales.
